messages:
Hannah: Hi team — quick onboarding/payroll questions. I enrolled in benefits but don’t see dental on my confirmation email. Did I need to opt in separately?
Hannah: Also my offer mentioned a $500 "home setup" reimbursement. Do I file that in Expensify or will Recruiting push it to payroll?
people-ops-bot: Welcome Hannah! Links: benefits portal https://benefits.redwood.example, expenses https://expenses.redwood.example (SSO).
Maya (People Ops): Congrats and welcome! Dental is a separate election in the benefits portal. If you missed it during initial enrollment you have 30 days from hire to add it; coverage would start the 1st of the month after processing.
Maya (People Ops): Home setup: if your offer says "reimbursement" submit receipts to Expensify and tag "Home-Setup-2026". If it says "stipend" it would be payroll. Which wording do you have?
Hannah: Offer says "one-time home office reimbursement up to $500 upon submission of receipts."
Lina (Payroll): That reads as reimbursement — use Expensify. Once approved Finance processes reimbursements in the next reimb cycle (about 7 business days). Make sure receipts are attached and include the recruiting approval email in the comments.
Jules (Recruiting): I approved the home setup for Hannah. I'll forward the approval email to Finance to speed it up.
Hannah: Thanks. One more: I set up direct deposit last night but Workday still shows pending. First paycheck is Friday — should I be worried?
Lina (Payroll): If it shows pending it likely missed the payroll cutoff. If you want it applied this cycle it has to be set before cutoff. If you miss it, the deposit will appear on the next pay; we can also issue a one-time manual ACH if needed — email payroll@redwood.example with a request.
Hannah: Got it — I think I was just after cutoff. Also, FSA question: can I add transit to FSA after initial enrollment?
Maya (People Ops): Transit (commuter) elections must be made during initial enrollment to be pre-tax for the plan year. You can change only during open enrollment or after a qualifying life event.
Hannah: Great — thanks everyone. Ill submit the receipts to Expensify now and tag this thread.
Maya (People Ops): Perfect — tag us after submit and Ill confirm when Finance marks it processed. Welcome aboard! :tada:
